name: G1on series
summary: Same ZDL family. NAM loader effects reported working on a G1Xon 1.21; other models unconfirmed.

firmware.flash: Effects are installed with Zoom Effect Manager 2.3.3 or later over USB; the OS is not modified.
firmware.recovery: Remove the effect in Effect Manager. If a bad effect freezes the pedal at boot, run All Initialize (hold the leftmost knob while powering on), then remove the effect.
